title: Default Brave API key support is inconsistent between exposure and execution
reasoning: The exposure/capability path only reports Brave availability when cfg.brave_search.api_key_env is non-empty, but execution falls back to BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY when that config field is empty. With only BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY set, should_expose_backend_web_search_tool() can hide the tool while WebSearchTool.run() can still execute it. That creates a registry/runtime contract mismatch and makes configuration behavior depend on which code path is consulted.
recommendation: Use the same API-key resolution semantics for capability checks and execution. Either remove the default fallback from execution or add the same BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY fallback to has_brave_search_api_key().
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were included for Brave availability detection with cfg.brave_search.api_key_env unset and BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY present.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a capability test where cfg.brave_search.api_key_env is empty, BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY is set, and assert exposure and execution-mode resolution match the intended default-key behavior.
minimumFixScope: Align has_brave_search_api_key() and _resolve_api_key() semantics, then cover the default-env case.
